title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
title_zh: 绿色代码还是高昂代码？评估基于大语言模型的迭代式代码优化的能耗成本

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption. We challenge this assumption empirically by measuring whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement pipelines is also energy-efficient relative to canonical human reference solutions, and whether the energy cost of the optimization process can be offset by subsequent execution-time savings. We evaluate 11 open-source models across four decoding configurations on all 1,000 problems of EffiBench, a state-of-the-art performance benchmark, while collecting per-process, hardware-level energy measurements throughout. Inference energy spans 0.79–8.68 MJ across model-variant pairs, which is roughly equivalent to the energy of 250–2800 GPT-4.1 queries. Limiting the maximum number of output tokens has the largest impact, reducing energy use by up to 69% compared to the default configuration. On the execution side, 42 of 44 configurations produce code that consumes more energy per problem than the canonical human reference, with overheads ranging from +4% to +886%. The two exceptions achieve only marginal gains, with break-even points on the order of 10 6 10^{6} – 10 7 10^{7} executions. Mixture-of-Experts architectures consume substantially less inference energy than equivalently-sized dense models without sacrificing correctness, making architectural choice a more consequential sustainability lever than decoding parameters. Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not always aligned goals: LLM self-refinement consistently produces faster-seeking but energy-heavier code relative to what a human engineer would write. All artifacts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23598170 .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于对代码进行性能优化。 这种做法通常假设执行速度的提升会自然转化为整体能耗的降低。 我们通过实证检验挑战了这一假设：测量由 LLM 自我改进流水线生成的性能优化代码，相较于规范化的人类参考解法是否同样具备能效，以及优化过程本身的能源成本能否被后续执行时间的节省所抵消。 我们在 EffiBench 这一最先进的性能基准的全部 1,000 道问题上，评估了 11 个开源模型在四种解码配置下的表现，并全程采集每个进程的硬件级能耗测量数据。 推理能耗在不同模型-变体组合之间跨度为 0.79–8.68 MJ，大致相当于 250–2800 次 GPT-4.1 查询的能耗。 限制最大输出 token 数量的影响最大，与默认配置相比最多可减少 69% 的能耗。 在执行侧，44 种配置中有 42 种生成的代码每题能耗高于规范化的人类参考解法，开销范围为 +4% 至 +886%。 仅有的两个例外也只取得了微弱的收益，其盈亏平衡点在 10^{6}–10^{7} 次执行的数量级。 混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构在不牺牲正确性的前提下，推理能耗显著低于同等规模的稠密模型，这使得架构选择成为比解码参数更具影响力的可持续性杠杆。 性能优化与能效并不总是目标一致的目标：相较于人类工程师所编写的代码，LLM 自我改进持续产出运行更快但能耗更高的代码。 所有产出物均可通过 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23598170 获取。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies indicate that developers routinely integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into their daily coding workflows [ 1 , 2 ] . Beyond code generation, LLMs are used to iteratively refine code to reduce execution time and memory usage, tasks that previously required expert manual effort [ 3 ] . This growing practice implicitly assumes that performance improvements also translate into environmental benefits: that faster code is greener code. However, each optimization interaction carries two distinct energy costs: the inference energy consumed when the model produces code [ 4 , 5 ] , and the execution energy consumed when that code is later run [ 6 ] . Both costs are largely invisible to the developer, yet together determine whether an optimization yields a net energy benefit. However, it remains unclear whether the execution-time savings can offset the energy required to generate the optimization, or whether LLM-optimized code is more energy-efficient than code written by human developers [ 7 , 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 最近的研究表明，开发者已普遍将大语言模型（LLM）融入其日常编码工作流 [ 1 , 2 ] 。 除代码生成之外，LLM 还被用于迭代式地优化代码，以减少执行时间和内存占用，而这些任务此前需要专家的人工投入 [ 3 ] 。 这种日益增长的做法隐含地假设性能提升同时也会带来环境效益：即更快的代码就是更环保的代码。 然而，每一次优化交互都包含两种不同的能源成本：模型生成代码时所消耗的推理能耗 [ 4 , 5 ] ，以及这些代码随后运行时所消耗的执行能耗 [ 6 ] 。 这两种成本在很大程度上对开发者是不可见的，但它们共同决定了一次优化能否带来净能耗收益。 然而，执行时间的节省能否抵消生成优化所需的能耗，或者 LLM 优化后的代码是否比人类开发者编写的代码更节能，这些问题仍不明确 [ 7 , 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Coignion et al. [ 9 ] introduce the Break-Even Point (BEP), defined as the number of executions at which cumulative execution savings offset generation cost, and find that this point ranges from under 100 to over 200,000 executions depending on the large language model and the method that is being optimized. However, their analysis measures savings relative to each model’s own unoptimized output rather than a canonical human-written solution. This distinction is important because a model can greatly improve upon its own baseline while still producing code that is less efficient than a competent human solution. As a result, it remains unclear whether LLM-optimized code is actually competitive with what a competent human engineer would produce.
paragraphs.zh: Coignion 等人。 [ 9 ] 提出了盈亏平衡点（Break-Even Point，BEP）的概念，定义为累计执行节省抵消生成成本所需的执行次数，并发现该点根据所使用的大语言模型以及被优化的方法的不同，范围从不到 100 次到超过 200,000 次执行不等。 然而，他们的分析衡量的是相对于每个模型自身未优化输出的节省，而不是相对于一个标准的人工编写的解决方案。 这一区别很重要，因为一个模型可以在自身基线的基础上大幅改进，但产出的代码在效率上仍可能逊色于一个称职的人类解决方案。 因此，大语言模型优化后的代码是否真的能与一个称职的人类工程师所产出的结果相竞争，仍然不得而知。

paragraphs.en: We investigate this question by evaluating the energy consumptioon of LLM-based code optimization end-to-end. We use EffiLearner [ 3 ] , a state-of-the-art iterative self-refinement pipeline for code performance optimization, to generate optimized solutions. We evaluate these solutions against the canonical human-written reference implementations in EffiBench [ 10 ] , a benchmark of 1,000 LeetCode problems paired with top-rated human solutions. We evaluate only open-source models deployed on-premise. Such deployments are increasingly adopted in privacy-sensitive environments, while also allowing us to instrument the underlying hardware and obtain precise, hardware-level measurements of inference energy rather than relying on estimates or provider-reported statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过端到端地评估基于大语言模型的代码优化的能耗来研究这个问题。 我们使用 EffiLearner [ 3 ] ——一种最先进的用于代码性能优化的迭代式自我改进流水线——来生成优化后的解决方案。 我们将这些解决方案与 EffiBench [ 10 ] 中的规范的人类编写的参考实现进行比较，该基准测试包含 1,000 道 LeetCode 题目及其配套的评分最高的人类解答。 我们仅评估部署在本地（on-premise）的开源模型。 此类部署在隐私敏感的环境中日益普及，同时也使我们能够监测底层硬件，从而获得推理能耗的精确硬件级测量数据，而不必依赖估算值或服务提供商报告的统计数字。

paragraphs.en: Addressing the practical value of LLM-based optimization requires examining three different aspects. First, the optimization process itself incurs an energy cost that must be quantified. Second, this cost may vary substantially across models and decoding strategies, potentially changing the trade-off between optimization quality and energy consumption. Finally, the generation investment is worthwhile only if the resulting code consumes less execution energy than a strong human-written baseline, allowing the initial energy cost to be recovered over repeated executions. These considerations motivate the following research questions:

paragraphs.en: We present the first end-to-end energy evaluation of iterative LLM-based code optimization against canonical human-written reference solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首次针对基于大语言模型（LLM）的迭代式代码优化与规范的人类编写参考解法进行了端到端的能耗评估。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a large-scale empirical study of the energy cost of LLM-based code optimization across 11 open-source models and multiple decoding configurations, providing a systematic characterization of the factors that influence inference energy and optimization cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对基于大语言模型的代码优化的能耗成本进行了一项大规模实证研究，涵盖 11 个开源模型和多种解码配置，系统地刻画了影响推理能耗与优化成本的因素。

paragraphs.en: We release all experimental artifacts, including repaired EffiBench benchmark, to support reproducibility and future research on energy-efficient LLM-based code optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发布了所有实验产物，包括修复后的 EffiBench 基准，以支持可复现性以及未来基于大语言模型的高能效代码优化研究。

paragraphs.en: Findings in brief. Our results show that inference energy ranges from 0.79 to 8.68 MJ across model–configuration pairs, equivalent to roughly 250–2800 GPT-4.1 queries [ 11 ] . Among the evaluated decoding parameters, limiting the maximum output length has by far the greatest impact, reducing inference energy by 13–69% relative to the default configuration.

paragraphs.en: On the inference side, Samsi et al. [ 5 ] provide the most detailed power profile of LLaMA inference across deployments, observing system draws between 300 W and 1 kW, while a study [ 26 ] estimates that at ChatGPT-scale traffic, inference matches the energy cost of training in just about 2 days. LASSI-EE [ 22 ] is the closest prior pipeline to ours in spirit: an iterative, self-correcting LLM loop with runtime power-profile feedback applied to HPC code, reporting 36% and 34% energy reductions on MI100 and A100 respectively. Like the training-focused studies above, however, it does not connect inference and execution energy through a break-even analysis, and targets bespoke HPC kernels rather than a standardised benchmark like EffiBench. Crucially, no prior work jointly measures inference and execution energy across a controlled decoding parameter sweep on a standardised benchmark, which is the gap this paper fills.

paragraphs.en: Several recent studies have identified output token length as the dominant inference energy driver. Poddar et al. [ 13 ] report a Pearson correlation of r = 0.952 r=0.952 between output tokens and energy, against r = 0.697 r=0.697 for input tokens. Adamska et al. [ 14 ] independently measure r = 0.9 r=0.9 on a separate corpus and find that prompt phrasing can influence response length. Both findings emerge as observational correlations across natural output variation rather than from controlled ablations of the output-token budget as an independent variable. To our knowledge, no prior study provides an isolated, controlled measurement of sampling temperature , context window size , or maximum output tokens as independent inference-energy levers while holding the remaining factors constant. Furthermore, both studies focus on general NLP tasks such as classification, question answering, and summarization; neither examines code generation or optimization pipelines, where output structure and length distributions differ substantially from natural language responses. Controlled comparisons do exist for the software stack. Georgiou et al. [ 15 ] measure training and inference energy of six deep learning models under matched configurations in PyTorch and TensorFlow, and report statistically significant differences between the frameworks in 94% of the energy and runtime comparisons, with comparable accuracy and no single framework superior across all tasks. The factor they vary is the framework, however, and the models they study are not applied to code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的若干研究已将输出 token 长度确定为推理能耗的主要驱动因素。Poddar 等人 [13] 报告了输出 token 与能耗之间的皮尔逊相关系数 r=0.952，而输入 token 的相关系数为 r=0.697。Adamska 等人 [14] 在另一个独立语料库上独立测得 r=0.9，并发现提示词的措辞会影响响应长度。 这两项发现都是基于自然输出变化之上的观察性相关性，而非将输出 token 预算作为独立变量进行受控消融实验所得出的结果。 据我们所知，此前尚无研究在保持其余因素不变的情况下，将采样温度、上下文窗口大小或最大输出 token 数作为独立的推理能耗杠杆进行孤立的、受控的测量。 此外，这两项研究都聚焦于分类、问答和摘要等一般性 NLP 任务，均未考察代码生成或优化流水线，而在这些场景中，输出结构和长度分布与自然语言响应存在显著差异。 针对软件栈的受控比较确实存在。Georgiou 等人 [15] 在 PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 中以匹配的配置测量了六个深度学习模型的训练和推理能耗，并报告在 94% 的能耗与运行时间比较中两个框架之间存在统计学上的显著差异，而准确率相当，且没有任何一个框架在所有任务上都占优。 然而，他们所改变的因素是框架，且他们所研究的模型并未应用于代码生成。

paragraphs.en: Empirical consensus establishes that LLM-generated code is systematically less efficient than canonical human solutions. EffiBench [ 10 ] , which evaluated 42 models, found that even the best open-source model (StarCoder2-15B) required 2.59 × \times the execution time and 1.71 × \times the peak memory of human solutions. Islam et al. [ 7 ] extend this picture on 878 EffiBench problems, finding that the best model (DeepSeek-v3) remains 1.17 × \times less energy-efficient than humans, with gaps reaching 449 × \times for dynamic programming and bit-manipulation tasks. Convergent findings come from Tuttle et al. [ 20 ] , who report LLMs outperforming human solutions in only 5.7% of 192 LeetCode responses. Apsan et al. [ 21 ] , who show the human–LLM gap persists across server, PC, and Raspberry Pi platforms. Solovyeva et al. [ 8 ] , who find parity only in narrow regimes such as String and Tree tasks; and Rani et al. [ 23 ] , who document that LLM-suggested optimizations on Matlab often unintentionally increase memory and energy usage. Whether iterative self-refinement can close this gap, and at what inference cost, motivates the methodological thread we build on.
paragraphs.zh: 实证共识表明，大语言模型生成的代码在系统上比规范的人类解决方案效率更低。 EffiBench [ 10 ] 评估了 42 个模型，发现即使是最好的开源模型（StarCoder2-15B）也需要 2.59 × \times 的执行时间和 1.71 × \times 的峰值内存，才达到人类方案的水平。 Islam 等人 [ 7 ] 在 878 个 EffiBench 问题上进一步扩展了这一结论，发现最好的模型（DeepSeek-v3）的能效仍然比人类低 1.17 × \times，而在动态规划和位操作任务上差距可达 449 × \times。 Tuttle 等人也得出了趋同的结论。 [ 20 ] 他们报告称，在 192 个 LeetCode 回答中，大语言模型仅在 5.7% 的情况下优于人类解决方案。Apsan 等人 [ 21 ] 他们表明，人类与大语言模型之间的差距在服务器、PC 和树莓派平台上持续存在。Solovyeva 等人 [ 8 ] 他们发现仅在 String 和 Tree 任务等狭窄的场景中才能达到同等水平；以及 Rani 等人 [ 23 ] 他们记录到，大语言模型在 Matlab 上建议的优化往往会无意中增加内存和能耗。 迭代式自我完善能否缩小这一差距，以及需要付出多大的推理成本，正是我们所依托的方法论脉络的出发点。

paragraphs.en: The methodological precursor to our pipeline is EffiLearner [ 3 ] , which iteratively refines LLM-generated code by feeding execution-overhead profiles back to the model as structured prompts, demonstrating consistent reductions in Normalized Execution Time (NET) and Normalized Total Memory Usage (NTMU) across 22 models, but without measuring inference energy and therefore unable to answer whether the optimization investment is recovered at execution time. Coignion et al. [ 9 ] first formalised this question via the BEP ( B ​ E ​ P = E optim / ( e orig − e opt ) BEP=E_{\text{optim}}/(e_{\text{orig}}-e_{\text{opt}}) ), finding results spanning four orders of magnitude: DeepSeek-R1-14B with EoH yields 49% per-execution savings but requires 220,324 executions to break even, while pathologically inefficient code can drop from 318 J to 2.6 J and break even within 100 runs. Critically, their BEP measures savings relative to each model’s own unoptimized output rather than a canonical human reference, leaving open the question of whether LLM-optimized code is competitive with what a human engineer would write.

paragraphs.en: Most of the above studies address either (i) the inference energy of LLMs in general NLP settings, (ii) the runtime efficiency of LLM-generated code relative to human references, or (iii) the break-even economics of LLM-based optimization relative to each model’s own unoptimized output. No prior study jointly measures inference energy across a controlled decoding parameter sweep, evaluates the resulting code against canonical human solutions, and applies a break-even analysis within a multi-epoch self-refinement pipeline on a standardised benchmark. Our study is designed to fill this intersection.
paragraphs.zh: 上述大多数研究要么只关注(i)一般自然语言处理场景下大语言模型的推理能耗，要么只关注(ii)大语言模型生成代码相对于人类参考代码的运行效率，要么只关注(iii)基于大语言模型的优化相对于各模型自身未优化输出的盈亏平衡经济学。 此前没有研究同时在受控的解码参数扫描过程中测量推理能耗、将生成的代码与标准的人类解答进行评估，并在标准化基准上的多轮次自我完善流程中进行盈亏平衡分析。 我们的研究旨在填补这一交叉领域的空白。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on EffiBench [ 10 ] , a benchmark of 1,000 efficiency-critical LeetCode problems spanning 171 Easy , 589 Medium , and 240 Hard problems. Each entry pairs a problem description with an executable canonical solution drawn from top-starred LeetCode Discussion Forum submissions, a test-case generator, and 100 test cases. The canonical solutions serve as the human reference baseline for our RQ3 break-even analysis. Because they are top-starred submissions, they represent highly efficient human implementations rather than average developer code, and we discuss the implications in Section VI .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 EffiBench [10] 上进行评估，该基准包含 1,000 道对效率要求严苛的 LeetCode 题目，涵盖 171 道 Easy、589 道 Medium 和 240 道 Hard 难度的问题。 每个条目将一道题目描述与一个可执行的规范解法（取自 LeetCode 讨论论坛中获星最多的提交）、一个测试用例生成器以及 100 个测试用例配对。 这些规范解法作为我们 RQ3 盈亏平衡分析的人类参考基线。 由于它们是获星最多的提交，因此代表的是高效的人类实现而非普通开发者的代码，我们将在第 VI 节中讨论其影响。

paragraphs.en: EffiBench is particularly well suited to our study because its algorithmically challenging problems exhibit substantial variation in execution time, making differences in execution energy measurable.
paragraphs.zh: EffiBench 特别适合我们的研究，因为其算法上具有挑战性的问题在执行时间上表现出显著差异，使得执行能耗的差异可以被测量。

paragraphs.en: The EffiBench test cases were generated by GPT-3.5 Turbo, and during our validation run we found that 122 of the 1,000 problems contained defects preventing correct execution, all originating in the generated test cases rather than the solutions themselves. The most common defects were ordering-sensitive assertions on unordered outputs, missing helper utilities for tree and linked-list construction, object-address serialization embedding raw in-memory representations, wrong precomputed expected values, method-name mismatches, redundant class redefinitions shadowing the actual implementation, and empty test cases caused by generator logic that emitted no output. For each defect type we applied a targeted repair, recomputing expected values from the canonical solution, injecting missing helpers, rewriting object references as constructor calls, removing shadowing definitions, and converting ordering-sensitive assertions to order-independent equivalents. After repair, all 1,000 canonical solutions pass their respective test cases.
paragraphs.zh: EffiBench 的测试用例由 GPT-3.5 Turbo 生成，在验证运行中我们发现 1,000 道题中有 122 道存在阻碍正确执行的缺陷，这些缺陷全部源于生成的测试用例而非解答本身。 最常见的缺陷包括：对无序输出施加顺序敏感的断言、缺少用于构造树和链表的辅助工具、将对象地址序列化并内嵌原始内存表示、预先计算的期望值错误、方法名不匹配、冗余的类重定义遮蔽了实际实现，以及因生成器逻辑未输出任何内容而导致的空测试用例。 针对每种缺陷类型我们都进行了定向修复，包括从标准解答重新计算期望值、注入缺失的辅助函数、将对象引用改写为构造函数调用、移除遮蔽性定义，以及将顺序敏感的断言转换为顺序无关的等价形式。 修复后，全部 1,000 个标准解答均通过各自的测试用例。

paragraphs.en: We adopt EffiLearner [ 3 ] as our self-refinement pipeline because it directly targets execution-time and memory efficiency through line-level profiling feedback, and has been shown to produce significantly more efficient code across a wide range of model architectures, achieving state-of-the-art reductions in execution time and memory usage compared to alternative self-refinement approaches. EffiLearner structures code optimization as an iterative refinement loop comprising three stages: code generation, overhead profiling, and code refinement. Given a task description, the LLM first produces an initial code candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用 EffiLearner [ 3 ] 作为我们的自我优化流水线，因为它通过行级性能剖析反馈直接针对执行时间和内存效率，并且已被证明能在多种模型架构上生成效率显著更高的代码，与其他自我优化方法相比，在执行时间和内存占用方面实现了最先进的降幅。 EffiLearner 将代码优化构建为一个包含三个阶段的迭代优化循环：代码生成、开销剖析和代码优化。 给定任务描述后，大语言模型首先生成一个初始代码候选。

paragraphs.en: At each iteration, the current candidate is executed locally against the set of open test cases provided by the benchmark, and two line-level overhead profiles are collected: an execution-time profile via line_profiler and a memory-usage profile via memory_profiler . Each profiling measurement is repeated 60 times per script, and the reported Execution Time (ET), Max Memory Usage (MU), and Total Memory Usage (TMU) values are the averages over those 60 runs. To minimize the influence of thermal throttling and background load, a cooldown period of 15 seconds is enforced between consecutive runs. A run is only admitted once CPU load falls below 50% and the CPU package temperature is within the 50–60 °C range. Both profiles aggregate measurements across all open test cases and report, per line, the cumulative time and memory footprint. The current candidate, its overhead profiles, the task description, and the open test cases are then concatenated into a refinement prompt and passed back to the LLM, which emits a revised candidate. The revised candidate is validated for functional correctness against the open test cases only; if it passes, it replaces the current candidate as the input to the next iteration. The loop terminates after a fixed number of iterations. Final evaluation is conducted on a held-out set of private test cases disjoint from the open test cases, following the protocol of EffiBench [ 10 ] .

paragraphs.en: Models were selected by querying the Arena Leaderboard on Hugging Face 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/spaces/lmarena-ai/arena-leaderboard , accessed March 2025 and sorting by coding performance. We restricted our selection to open-source models deployed entirely on-premise, as local inference enables controlled energy measurement on a fixed, instrumented hardware environment and reflects the growing adoption of local deployment in privacy-sensitive settings. We selected representative size variants from the top-performing families, ensuring architectural diversity across both dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to enable a controlled comparison of their energy and quality characteristics. The resulting set of 11 models spans four families [ 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 ] , different size scales, and two architectural classes, as listed in Table II .

paragraphs.en: For each model, we run four configurations that each change at most one parameter, so that energy differences can be attributed to a single cause. We vary only deployment levers that practitioners can adjust without retraining and that act on energy through the number of generated tokens or the memory provisioned for generation. The default configuration uses temperature 0 (greedy decoding) and a maximum output length of 2,048 tokens. The sampling variant raises the temperature to 0.5 0.5 . In a pilot experiment, temperatures above 0.5 0.5 increased verbosity and inference energy without improving code efficiency, so we did not sweep higher values. The reduced-context variant caps the context window at 64k tokens, since all evaluated models support windows three to four times larger by default. The reduced-output variant halves the maximum output length to 1,024 tokens to test whether a shorter generation budget lowers energy without hurting optimization quality. A full factorial sweep was timely infeasible.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个模型，我们运行四种配置，每种配置至多改变一个参数，从而能够将能耗差异归因于单一原因。 我们只改变从业者无需重新训练即可调整、且通过生成 token 的数量或为生成所配置的内存来影响能耗的部署手段。 默认配置使用温度 0（贪心解码）和 2,048 个 token 的最大输出长度。 采样变体将温度提高到 0.5 0.5 。 在一项试点实验中，高于 0.5 0.5 的温度增加了冗长程度和推理能耗，却未能提升代码效率，因此我们没有扫描更高的值。 缩减上下文变体将上下文窗口限制在 64k 个 token，因为所有被评估的模型默认支持三到四倍于该大小的窗口。 缩减输出变体将最大输出长度减半至 1,024 个 token，以检验更短的生成预算能否在不损害优化质量的情况下降低能耗。 全因子扫描在当时是不可行的。

paragraphs.en: All experiments were conducted on a server equipped with two Intel Xeon Gold 6438Y+ processors with 128 logical cores in total, 1 TB of system memory, and two NVIDIA L40 GPUs with 46 GB GDDR6 VRAM each. Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT) was enabled and the system exposed two Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) nodes. The server ran Ubuntu 24.04 with Linux kernel 6.8.0-138, and models were served locally via vLLM [ 32 ] . Processes were pinned to physical cores, while the frequency governor, turbo boost, C-states, and NUMA policy remained at their operating system defaults to reflect standard deployments. The full experimental pipeline required approximately 30 days of continuous execution.

paragraphs.en: We instrument all experiments with Metrion [ 33 ] , an energy measurement tool that attributes energy consumption to processes at the thread level. Most existing tools neglect the combined effects of frequency scaling, simultaneous multithreading, and non-uniform memory access in multi-socket architectures. Utilization-based tools like CodeCarbon [ 34 ] estimate process-level energy from coarse-grained CPU time and RAPL values without accounting for these hardware-level effects, while profiling utilities like perf expose RAPL metrics only at the package level. Metrion overcomes these limitations by combining Intel RAPL, nvidia-smi, and Hardware Performance Counters (HWPCs) to attribute CPU, DRAM, and GPU energy at the thread level, with HWPCs resolving per-thread footprints within each 1-second sampling window. Metrion does not require a process to span an entire sampling interval. It uses eBPF and HWPCs to trace when each process is scheduled on or off the CPU and to count its unhalted cycles, and it allocates the RAPL package energy, sampled at 1 Hz, to active processes in proportion to their unhalted cycles in each interval. This attributes energy correctly even to short-lived processes. Frequency scaling and hardware topology are handled at attribution time. Metrion weights active cycles by the APERF/MPERF ratio, which reflects the actual frequency under Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) and Turbo Boost, scales overlapping SMT threads by a calibrated contention factor of 1.15, and attributes energy per socket. Energy is aggregated over all descendant threads of each solution process, yielding a per-solution breakdown into CPU, DRAM, and GPU, each decomposed into active and idle components.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为所有实验配备了 Metrion [ 33 ]，这是一种能量测量工具，能够在线程层面将能耗归因到各个进程。 现有的大多数工具都忽略了多路（multi-socket）架构中频率调节、同时多线程和非一致性内存访问的共同影响。 像 CodeCarbon [ 34 ] 这类基于利用率的工具，仅依据粗粒度的 CPU 时间和 RAPL 数值来估算进程级能耗，而未考虑这些硬件层面的影响；而像 perf 这类性能剖析工具只能在处理器封装（package）层面暴露 RAPL 指标。 Metrion 通过结合 Intel RAPL、nvidia-smi 和硬件性能计数器（HWPCs）克服了这些局限，能够在线程层面归因 CPU、DRAM 和 GPU 的能耗，并由 HWPCs 在每个 1 秒的采样窗口内解析出各线程的能耗足迹。 Metrion 不要求进程覆盖整个采样区间。 它使用 eBPF 和 HWPCs 来追踪每个进程何时被调度到 CPU 上或从 CPU 上调离，并统计其非停机周期数，然后将按 1 Hz 频率采样的 RAPL 封装能耗，按照各活跃进程在每个区间内的非停机周期数比例进行分摊。 这样即使是很短生命周期的进程也能被正确地归因能耗。 频率调节和硬件拓扑在归因阶段进行处理。 Metrion 使用 APERF/MPERF 比值对活跃周期进行加权，该比值反映了动态电压与频率调节（DVFS）和睿频加速（Turbo Boost）下的实际频率；同时用经过校准的争用因子 1.15 对重叠的 SMT 线程进行缩放，并按每个处理器插槽（socket）进行能耗归因。 能量在求解进程的所有后代线程上聚合，得到每个求解的分解结果，细分为 CPU、DRAM 和 GPU，其中每一项又进一步分解为活跃与空闲两个组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Each (model, configuration) pair is executed six times in full, covering all 1,000 problems per run. paragraphs.en: Each solution script is executed 60 times sequentially within one persistent Python interpreter, and the reported E exec E_{\text{exec}} is the mean over those 60 runs. Keeping the interpreter alive amortizes startup and import overhead, so the measurement reflects steady-state energy. Canonical and LLM-generated solutions share an identical harness, so any residual overhead affects both symmetrically. Individual executions average more than 0.1 seconds, so the 60 sequential executions of each solution give cumulative measurement windows well over one second. The higher repetition count relative to inference is feasible because individual script executions are cheaper. The same cooldown protocol applied to resource profiling is used here: a 15-second pause is enforced between consecutive executions, and a run is only admitted once CPU load is below 50% and the CPU package temperature is within the 50–60 °C range. These admission criteria prevent cross-experiment interference and thermal throttling.
paragraphs.zh: 每个求解脚本在一个持久的 Python 解释器中被连续执行 60 次，所报告的 E exec E_{\text{exec}} 是这 60 次运行的平均值。 让解释器保持存活可以摊销启动和导入开销，因此该测量反映的是稳态能耗。 规范解与 LLM 生成的解使用完全相同的测试框架，因此任何残余开销对两者的影响是对称的。 单次执行平均超过 0.1 秒，因此每个解的 60 次连续执行提供了远超一秒的累计测量窗口。 相比推理，更高的重复次数之所以可行，是因为单次脚本执行的成本更低。 这里采用了与资源剖析相同的冷却协议：在连续执行之间强制暂停 15 秒，且只有当 CPU 负载低于 50% 且 CPU 封装温度处于 50–60 °C 范围内时，才允许开始一次运行。 这些准入标准可防止跨实验干扰和热节流。

paragraphs.en: The infrastructure described above produces two complementary energy measurements at different granularities. For each (model, configuration) pair, we record the aggregate generation energy E gen E_{\text{gen}} expended by the LLM during the entire generation and optimization run across all 1,000 problems. For each (model, configuration, problem) triple, it additionally records the per-process execution energy E exec E_{\text{exec}} consumed when running the resulting solution script. paragraphs.en: This section presents results for three research questions: the energy cost of LLM-based code optimization (Section IV-A ), how that cost varies across models and decoding configurations (Section IV-B ), and whether the generation investment breaks even against execution-time savings relative to canonical solutions (Section IV-C ).

paragraphs.en: Table IV reports the inference energy consumed during the five-epoch optimization loop and shows that total inference energy varies considerably across models. Ministral-3B is the most energy-efficient at 1.27 MJ, followed by Qwen3.5-4B at 1.38 MJ. Qwen3.5-27B incurs the highest cost at 8.58 MJ, reflecting its larger parameter count. GLM-4.7-Flash is the second most expensive at 6.08 MJ despite achieving only 25.02% pass@1, making it the least cost-effective configuration overall. Notably, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B consumes only 3.12 MJ despite having more total parameters than Qwen3.5-27B. This is due to its MoE architecture, which activates only a subset of parameters per token and therefore reduces the effective compute per inference step. CPU energy dominates across all models, accounting for 59–65% of E total E_{\mathrm{total}} , with GPU contributing the remainder and DRAM a negligible fraction ( < < 0.05%).

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , mt1024 produces the lowest total inference energy across all models, with reductions of up to 69% relative to default (mean 2.26 MJ vs. 3.37 MJ). The savings are largest for GLM-4.7-Flash (6.08 MJ → \to 1.87 MJ, − - 69.3%) and smallest for Qwen3.5-4B (1.38 MJ → \to 1.33 MJ, − - 3.8%), reflecting how strongly maximum output tokens constrains generation cost. The ctx65536 and t0.5 variants are broadly comparable to default in energy, with t0.5 reaching the highest absolute consumption for Qwen3.5-27B (8.68 MJ), likely due to more diverse and verbose outputs under sampling.

paragraphs.en: Qwen3.5-4B dominates across all four variants, achieving the highest efficiency of 37–40 % MJ -1 while maintaining NET below 1.0. Its ctx65536 variant reaches 40.15 % MJ -1 , the best single configuration in the study. Ministral-3B mt1024 is the best non-Qwen entry in the optimal region at 34.0 % MJ -1 . paragraphs.en: A break-even point N ∗ N^{*} exists only when the optimized code consumes less execution energy than the canonical solution on average. Under this criterion, 42 of the 44 configurations admit no break-even point : the energy invested in generation is never recovered regardless of how often the resulting code is executed. For the two configurations where a saving exists, the thresholds are prohibitively large. Qwen3.5-9B t0.5 requires approximately 3.4 × 10 6 3.4\times 10^{6} executions per problem to break even, and Nemotron-Cascade mt1024 requires approximately 6.4 × 10 7 6.4\times 10^{7} , thresholds reachable only in exceptional high-volume deployment scenarios. We discuss the broader implications for the energy economics of LLM-based code optimization in Section V .
paragraphs.zh: 只有当优化后的代码平均消耗的执行能量低于规范解法时，才存在盈亏平衡点 N^{*}。 在该标准下，44 个配置中有 42 个不存在盈亏平衡点：无论生成的代码被执行多少次，生成所投入的能量都无法收回。 对于存在节省的两种配置，其阈值也大得令人望而却步。 Qwen3.5-9B t0.5 每个问题大约需要 3.4×10^{6} 次执行才能达到盈亏平衡，而 Nemotron-Cascade mt1024 大约需要 6.4×10^{7} 次，这样的阈值只有在异常高流量的部署场景中才能达到。 我们将在第 V 节讨论基于大语言模型的代码优化对能量经济学的更广泛影响。

paragraphs.en: To translate energy measurements into sustainability-relevant units, we convert inference energy into operational carbon emissions using the global average grid intensity of γ = 217 \gamma=217 gCO 2 eq/kWh from Cheung et al. [ 35 ] ( γ = 60.3 ​ μ \gamma=60.3\,\mu gCO 2 eq/J). This value lies within the 23.92–625.57 kg/MWh range across 365 regional grids tracked by eco2AI [ 25 ] . Region-specific estimates can be obtained by scaling our figures by γ local / 217 \gamma_{\text{local}}/217 .

paragraphs.en: We now interpret the results across the three research questions and their broader implications for practitioners considering LLM-based code optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在结合三个研究问题来解读结果，并探讨其对考虑采用基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码优化的从业者的更广泛启示。

paragraphs.en: A central finding of this study is that the energy consumed during LLM-based self-optimization is substantial and largely unrecoverable. Across 42 of the 44 evaluated model-variant configurations, the optimized code consumes more execution energy per problem than the canonical human-written reference, and the generation investment requires millions of executions to break even in the two cases where a saving exists. Our results suggest that performance optimization and energy efficiency are not aligned goals: faster code does not automatically mean greener code when the cost of generation is accounted for. Coignion et al. [ 9 ] reached a similar conclusion on a different benchmark and pipeline, reporting weak correlation between performance gains and energy reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究的一个核心发现是：基于大语言模型（LLM）的自优化过程所消耗的能量十分巨大，且大部分无法挽回。 在 44 个被评估的模型变体配置中，有 42 个的优化代码在单个问题上消耗的执行能量高于人类编写的标准参考代码，而在仅存的两个存在节能的案例中，生成阶段的投入也需要数百万次执行才能实现收支平衡。 我们的结果表明，性能优化与能效并非一致的目标：当把生成成本计入后，更快的代码并不自动意味着更环保的代码。Coignion 等人 [ 9 ] 在不同的基准测试和流程上得出了类似的结论，报告称性能提升与能耗降低之间仅有较弱的相关性。

paragraphs.en: Our RQ2 analysis shows that the dominant factor in both inference energy and correctness-efficiency is the choice of model and its architecture, not decoding configuration. Constraining output length ( mt1024 ) consistently reduces inference energy across all models, but at the cost of correctness collapse in several configurations. The MoE architecture of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B achieves near-identical correctness to the larger Qwen3.5-27B dense model at less than half the inference energy, owing to sparse parameter activation, suggesting that architectural choices made upstream of deployment have a larger sustainability impact than parameter tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的RQ2分析表明，推理能耗与正确性-效率的主导因素是模型选择及其架构，而非解码配置。 限制输出长度（ mt1024 ）在所有模型中都能持续降低推理能耗，但在多种配置下会以正确性崩溃为代价。 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B的MoE架构凭借稀疏参数激活，以不到一半的推理能耗实现了与更大的Qwen3.5-27B稠密模型几乎相同的正确性，这表明在部署之前做出的架构选择比参数调优对可持续性的影响更大。

paragraphs.en: A subtler finding from RQ3 is that the EffiLearner pipeline does not drive consistent execution-energy reductions even relative to its own base epoch, with 54.5% of configurations regressing across the optimization trajectory. Future pipelines should incorporate execution energy as an explicit selection criterion alongside correctness.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based self-optimization is only energetically justified for code that will be executed at very high volume. For one-off scripts or lightly used utilities, the generation cost will never be recouped. Practitioners aiming to reduce overall energy consumption should restrict optimization to hot-path code with known high execution frequency and prefer smaller models such as Ministral-3B or Qwen3.5-4B when correctness requirements allow. The carbon footprint analysis (Section IV-D ) confirms that these differences are non-trivial at scale: the generation footprint of Qwen3.5-27B is approximately seven times that of Ministral-3B for the same optimization task.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的自我优化，只有在代码将以极高执行量运行时，才在能耗上是合理的。 对于一次性脚本或使用频率很低的工具，其生成成本永远无法收回。 希望降低整体能耗的从业者，应将优化限制在已知的、执行频率很高的热点路径代码上，并在正确性要求允许的情况下，优先选择较小的模型，例如 Ministral-3B 或 Qwen3.5-4B。 碳足迹分析（第 IV-D 节）证实，这些差异在规模化场景下并不可忽视：在同一个优化任务中，Qwen3.5-27B 的生成碳足迹约为 Ministral-3B 的七倍。

paragraphs.en: The findings reported in this study are bounded by deliberate experimental choices, each pointing to a concrete direction for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究报告的发现受限于有意的实验选择，而每一项选择都为未来的工作指明了一个具体的方向。

paragraphs.en: EffiBench problems are short, algorithmically dense, and complete in under a second, which is ideal for energy measurement at scale but unrepresentative of long-running workloads where break-even would most plausibly favor optimization. Future work should investigate whether the pass@1 collapse observed under aggressive decoding constraints persists on harder, more diverse tasks such as I/O-bound programs or data-processing pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: EffiBench 的题目短小、算法密集且可在一秒内完成，这非常适合大规模能耗测量，但不能代表长时间运行的工作负载，而恰恰是在这类工作负载中，能耗盈亏平衡最有可能倾向于优化的一方。 未来的工作应研究在激进解码约束下观察到的 pass@1 崩溃现象，是否会在更难、更多样化的任务上持续存在，例如 I/O 密集型程序或数据处理流水线。

paragraphs.en: The canonical EffiBench solutions are top-rated submissions from a competitive programming forum, so they represent highly efficient human implementations rather than the code an average practitioner would write. Our RQ3 comparison therefore measures LLM-optimized code against a strong reference. We also assign no authoring cost to the canonical solutions, whereas the generation cost of the LLM is fully counted. This omission does not affect our main finding. In 42 of 44 configurations the optimized code consumes more execution energy per run than the canonical code, so the recurring difference is negative and no authoring cost for the baseline can turn the generation energy into a net saving through repeated execution. It could only favor LLM-based optimization when a solution is executed few times. Future work should compare against solutions from a broader pool of practitioners and measure human authoring effort explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: EffiBench 的标准解答来自编程竞赛论坛上评分最高的提交，因此它们代表的是高效的人类实现，而非普通从业者会写出的代码。 因此，我们的 RQ3 比较衡量的是 LLM 优化代码相对于一个强大参照的表现。 我们也没有为标准解答计入任何编写成本，而 LLM 的生成成本则被完全计入。 这一省略并不影响我们的主要发现。 在 44 种配置中的 42 种里，优化代码每次运行消耗的执行能量都高于标准代码，因此重复执行的能量差为负值，基线无编写成本这一点也无法通过反复执行使生成能量转化为净节省。 只有当某个解答被执行的次数很少时，这一省略才可能对基于 LLM 的优化有利。 未来的工作应当与来自更广泛从业者群体的解答进行比较，并显式地测量人类的编写投入。

sents.zh: GPU 制造、数据中心冷却、模型训练以及硬件更换周期所产生的内含成本尚未被纳入考量，但其在硬件生命周期内的总量可能超过运行阶段的节能收益。

sents.en: Future work should adopt a lifecycle perspective accounting for these indirect impacts.
sents.zh: 未来的工作应采用生命周期视角，将这些间接影响纳入考量。

paragraphs.en: This paper presented a systematic measurement study of the energy economics of LLM-based code self-optimization, covering inference and execution cost across 11 open-source models, four decoding configurations, and 1,000 EffiBench problems. The central question was whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement is also energy-efficient relative to canonical solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 本文对基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码自优化的能源经济学进行了系统性的测量研究，涵盖了 11 个开源模型、四种解码配置以及 1,000 道 EffiBench 题目上的推理与执行成本。 核心问题是：相对于规范解法而言，由大语言模型自我精炼生成的性能优化代码是否同样具备能效。

sents.en: This paper presented a systematic measurement study of the energy economics of LLM-based code self-optimization, covering inference and execution cost across 11 open-source models, four decoding configurations, and 1,000 EffiBench problems.
sents.zh: 本文对基于大语言模型（LLM）的代码自优化的能源经济学进行了系统性的测量研究，涵盖了 11 个开源模型、四种解码配置以及 1,000 道 EffiBench 题目上的推理与执行成本。

sents.en: The central question was whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement is also energy-efficient relative to canonical solutions.
sents.zh: 核心问题是：相对于规范解法而言，由大语言模型自我精炼生成的性能优化代码是否同样具备能效。

paragraphs.en: Optimized code consumes more execution energy than the canonical reference in 42 of 44 model-variant pairs; the two exceptions achieve only marginal gains, with break-even points requiring millions of executions. Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not aligned even within the refinement trajectory: more than half of all configurations regress in execution energy relative to their base epoch, reflecting the absence of any energy-aware selection criterion in the pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 在44组模型-变体配对中，有42组的优化代码比规范参考版本消耗更多执行能量；仅有的两个例外也只取得了微弱的收益，其盈亏平衡点需要数百万次执行。 即使在优化轨迹内部，性能优化与能效也并不一致：超过一半的配置相对于其基础epoch在执行能量上出现退化，这反映出该流程中缺乏任何能耗感知的选择标准。

sents.en: Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not aligned even within the refinement trajectory: more than half of all configurations regress in execution energy relative to their base epoch, reflecting the absence of any energy-aware selection criterion in the pipeline.
sents.zh: 即使在优化轨迹内部，性能优化与能效也并不一致：超过一半的配置相对于其基础epoch在执行能量上出现退化，这反映出该流程中缺乏任何能耗感知的选择标准。

paragraphs.en: On the generation side, inference energy varies by nearly an order of magnitude across models, driven primarily by model size and architecture. MoE models such as Qwen3.5-35B-A3B offer substantially lower inference cost than equivalently-sized dense counterparts without sacrificing correctness, making architectural choice a more consequential sustainability lever than decoding parameters. Constraining output tokens ( mt1024 ) is the most effective parameter adjustment for reducing inference energy, but risks correctness collapse that must be weighed per model.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成侧，不同模型的推理能耗相差近一个数量级，主要由模型规模和架构决定。 像 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 这样的 MoE 模型在不牺牲正确性的情况下，推理成本显著低于同等规模的稠密模型，这使得架构选择成为比解码参数更具影响力的可持续性杠杆。 限制输出 token 数量（ mt1024 ）是降低推理能耗最有效的参数调整手段，但存在正确性崩溃的风险，必须针对每个模型进行权衡。

paragraphs.en: Practitioners should restrict LLM-based self-optimization to hot-path code with reliably high execution frequency, prefer small and MoE-based models when correctness allows, and treat generation energy as a first-class cost. Future work should extend this framework to compiled languages, long-running workloads, and energy-aware refinement pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 实践者应将基于大语言模型的自我优化限制在执行频率稳定较高的热路径代码上，在正确性允许的情况下优先使用小型模型和基于 MoE 的模型，并将生成能耗视为一等成本。 未来的工作应将这一框架扩展到编译型语言、长时间运行的工作负载以及能耗感知的改进流水线。
